correctness.rationale: Repaired final result correct for fixed integers a,b>=1, m=a+b, 0<delta<pi/12, -delta<Delta<delta and t downarrow 0. Gram eigenvalues are (m±|sum exp(2i theta_i)|)/2; compactness/no aliasing localizes low s to the rank-one diagonal, where s=||P theta|| (1+O(||P theta||²)). Overlap diagonal segment length sqrt(m)(-Delta) yields sqrt(m) v_(m-1)(-Delta)/(2delta)^m t^(m-1). At Delta=0, mixed-sign support meets diagonal at origin: bounded rescaling gives V_(a,b)/(2delta)^m t^m, V11=1 and V12=sqrt(2/3). Separation yields s²>=1-cos Delta by a two-row PSD sub-Gramian. Layer-cake proves E[s^-p], and bounded sigma_max proves E[kappa^p], finite precisely below those powers, divergent at equality; strictly positive common noise variance gives stated mean-squared error thresholds. The literal original claim incorrectly referred to negative powers of kappa, always <=1, and did not specify strictly positive noise variance in one sentence. Entire RESULT.md is corrected, with no increase of mathematical scope. Independent symbolic/numerical checks test specific consequences only; the unrestricted result rests on analytic arguments.

value.rationale: The fixed-m design boundary has substantive mathematical and statistical motivation: almost-sure rank is insufficient for expected inverse-Gram accuracy, and a single support-contact changes codimension and the exact hard-edge exponent. For m=3 the positive-variance mean-squared risk flips from infinite (overlap) to finite (touch), while m=4 suffices in overlap; separation supplies a quantitative deterministic gap. This is a sharp motivated classification and explicit natural cone invariant, not a normalization or arbitrary table entry. The corrections preserve the original value rather than claiming a broader theorem.

final_claim: For each fixed a,b>=1 and 0<delta<pi/12, -delta<Delta<delta, H with a iid phases uniform [-2delta,0] and b iid phases uniform [Delta,Delta+2delta] has P(s<t)~sqrt(m) v_(m-1)(-Delta)t^(m-1)/(2delta)^m when Delta<0 and P(s<t)~V_(a,b)t^m/(2delta)^m when Delta=0; when Delta>0, s>=sqrt(1-cos Delta). Here s=sigma_min(H) and V_(a,b) is the mixed-sign P-orthant volume. For p>0 the NEGATIVE moments of s and POSITIVE pth moments of kappa(H) are finite exactly at p<m-1 (overlap), p<m (contact), and all p (separated). V11=1, V12=V21=sqrt(2/3). For independent centered measurement noise of common strictly positive finite variance tau², m=3 has finite expected least-squares squared error at contact but not overlap; m=4 suffices in overlap.
limitations: Fixed m,a,b,delta,Delta; no uniformity as Delta approaches zero, no exact general closed form for cone V_(a,b), and no claim that the separated lower bound is optimal for m>2.
Proof requires equal-width independent uniform phase windows entirely in a projective arc shorter than pi/2.
Noise risk corollary is for independent centered errors with common STRICTLY POSITIVE finite variance; zero-noise cases are excluded explicitly.
